records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.picture_export#1
records.source: Exports use the supplied ``QImage`` or ``QPixmap`` rather than capturing the surrounding widget. PNG preserves the image's pixel dimensions and records the selected resolution as dots-per-metre metadata. PDF embeds the raster image on a page; it does not convert pixels into vector artwork.

records.translation: Exporten använder den angivna ``QImage`` eller ``QPixmap`` i stället för att fånga den omgivande widgeten. PNG bevarar bildens pixelmått och lagrar den valda upplösningen som metadata i punkter per meter. PDF bäddar in rasterbilden på en sida; pixlar omvandlas inte till vektorgrafik.

records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.picture_export#2
records.source: PDF page dimensions are computed from the image's pixel dimensions and export DPI, with a minimum of one millimetre for each dimension. The image fills the page with zero margins. This sets the printed size without using microscope pixel calibration.
